test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: Which of the following states is the second most populous state in India as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the provisional outcomes of the 2011 national census, Maharashtra is the second most populous state in India with a population of **112,374,333 **of which males and females are** 58,243,056 and 54,131,277 respectively.**
 
• With a **growing rate of 9.42%,** Maharashtra is the second most populous state of India.
 
• Maharashtra is one of India's biggest **commercial and industrial centres, which has led to its being known as the gateway of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to details from** Census 2011, Madhya Pradesh has a population of 7.27 Crores.** 
 
• According to details from **Census 2011, Rajasthan has population of 6.86 Crores.** 
 
• Total population of** West Bengal according to 2011 census is 91,276,115** of which male and female are **46,809,027 and 44,467,088 appropriately**. ​
